summary: Review B (security) re-review of Phase S2 at a670ab5 found no blocking defect. Commit b955a3e closes F1 and F2 of review-b-s2-882f068.json. A finding with any splitlines separator before a second finding now fails, and the scope rule now reads NUL-separated paths without strip. The probes found no new bypass. Five new nonblocking items and four carried items remain. The fix has no regression test in test_checker.py.
security_applicability_reason: test-strategy.md Phase S2 says 'Review B (security): applicable, full scope.' The remediation diff 882f068..a670ab5 changes the spec-review gate in skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py, which decides if a track can start Red.
nonblocking_findings: tests/spec_review_gate/test_checker.py: the remediation adds no regression test. The diff 882f068..a670ab5 changes only the checker and plan.md, and test_checker.py still has 21 tests. Recommendation for Green: add a case for a [Blocker] after LF, CR, and U+2028 in nonblocking_findings, and a case for the committed path ' measure/runs/x'. Each case must assert exit 1 and the exact message.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:356-357: a finding that ends with one splitlines separator other than LF passes, because splitlines gives one item and Python '.' matches the separator. Live probe: 'F1 [Major] x: y' plus CR, VT, FF, FS, GS, RS, NEL, U+2028, or U+2029 at the end gave exit 0. No second finding follows the separator, so the severity rule holds. Recommendation: reject a finding when finding != finding.rstrip() or when it contains a character of Unicode category Cc, Zl, or Zp.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:356-357: a finding that contains NUL, ESC, or U+202E (right-to-left override) passes. Live probe: 'F1 [Major] x: y' plus NUL, '\x1b[2K', U+202E, U+200B, or TAB, plus 'F2 [Blocker] z: real blocker' gave exit 0. The text stays on one line in one string, so this is not a hidden second finding. A terminal can show the text in a changed form. Recommendation: reject control and format characters in a finding.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:358,647-648: the gate prints a finding and a path without escape. Live probe: the finding 'F1 [Major] x: y\nPASS: spec-review gate passed' gave exit 1, but the output had the line 'PASS: spec-review gate passed'. The exit code stays correct. A tool or a person that reads the output text and not the exit code can read a false pass. Recommendation: print each finding and path with repr() or with escaped control characters.

skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:118,636: a committed path with a non-UTF-8 byte stops the checker with 'UnicodeDecodeError' and a traceback (exit 1). The git() helper decodes the '-z' output as strict UTF-8. Before the fix, git quoted the path in ASCII, so the gate printed a FAIL message. The gate fails closed, but a valid file below measure/runs/ with such a name also fails, with no clear message. Recommendation: read the '-z' output as bytes, and decode each path with errors='surrogateescape' or os.fsdecode.

Carried from review-b-s2-882f068.json, not routed, code unchanged: the gate does not check that --baseline is an ancestor of HEAD (lines 631-636); an uncommitted edit by the role is not caught; a committed symbolic link below measure/runs/ passes; paraphrase.proposes U+200B passes (line 346). The recommendations in that file stay valid.
